items.rule: USP <800> §§5–6: manipulations of sterile antineoplastic HD require ISO 5 externally vented C-PEC; negative-pressure C-SEC; no mandatory extra outside HEPA or CSTD for all compounding.
items.topic: USP <800> sterile hazardous drug

option_verdicts.basis: Externally vented ISO 5 containment is required for sterile HD manipulation.
C-SEC negative-pressure containment is continuous rather than shift-only.
Universal redundant HEPA at the exterior outlet is not an unconditional requirement.
CSTD for all compounding is not mandatory; administration has different duties.

items.rule: M.G.L. c112 §39D and Board Policy 2020-02; FD&C Act 503A copy restriction: a prescriber-documented individual medical difference can justify a nonroutine copy.
items.topic: Compounding commercially available drug copies

option_verdicts.basis: Lower price alone does not establish significant medical difference.
Pharmacist preference cannot supply prescriber-determined patient-specific medical need.
Prescriber-documented dye allergy and removal can represent significant clinical difference.
Local stock-out without FDA shortage or distinct need does not justify routine copying.

items.topic: Pharmacist prescribing of oral HIV PrEP

option_verdicts.basis: Qualifying §19F prescribing is not dependent on a CDTM agreement.
DPH expressly exempts personal MCSR when prescribing and dispensing occur at same site.
NPI and documentation remain mandatory; transfer to another site is not an excuse.
Same-location pharmacist may prescribe oral PrEP under statewide guidance if all criteria met.

items.rule: 42 CFR 2.31, 2.33, 2.63 (2024 Part2 rule compliant Feb16 2026): single TPO consent permits HIPAA TPO redisclosure, counseling notes separate consent, no general criminal subpoena exception.
items.topic: 2026 Part 2 consent and SUD counseling notes

option_verdicts.basis: Separately maintained SUD counseling notes are not included automatically in broad TPO consent.
Received ordinary TPO-consented Part2 records can be redisclosed under HIPAA with proceedings restriction.
Generic subpoena is not Part2-compliant legal-proceedings authorization.
SUD counseling notes generally need their own specific written consent.

items.rule: Poison Prevention Packaging Act §4(b), 16 CFR 1701.1: consumer request for conventional packaging can be specific or blanket, but a single-item waiver does not carry forward.
items.topic: PPPA prescription packaging and patient waiver

option_verdicts.basis: First patient-requested conventional container is allowed; separate unrelated Rx needs new or blanket waiver.
Consumer as well as prescriber can request conventional packaging.
One documented single-Rx waiver is not an automatic lifetime or blanket waiver.
Pharmacist's unilateral packaging change lacks the needed exemption/request.

items.rule: 21 USC 360eee-1 §582(d)(4): suspect quarantine and investigation; illegitimate-product 24h notification; retain investigation record six years; 2026 FDA exemption excluded in stem.
items.topic: DSCSA verification: suspect versus illegitimate product

option_verdicts.basis: Quarantine and promptly investigate once product is suspected.
24-hour FDA/trading-partner notice is not triggered by mere suspicion.
Upon illegitimate determination notify FDA and implicated immediate partners within 24h.
Maintain suspect investigation records for at least six years after investigation concludes.

items.rule: USP <797> §1.3 and USP FAQ #22/#25: no more than three different sterile products, not three vials; four hours from START; non-witnessed dose labeling.
items.topic: USP <797> immediate-use CSP: 3 products versus 4 containers

option_verdicts.basis: Two vials of identical drug count as one sterile product, not two distinct types.
Current USP immediate-use limit is not one hour after end of preparation.
Three distinct products, labeled, 3h50m from initiation meet the stated criteria.
Four-hour deadline is counted from start, not time finished.

items.rule: 105 CMR 222.100(A), .105(B): report new zoster vaccination ≤72h, MIIS sharing objection form to DPH ≤24h and update GUI; objection does not suspend reporting.
items.topic: MIIS objection: reporting versus data-sharing access

option_verdicts.basis: Patient's information-sharing objection does not cancel dose-reporting duty.
72h vaccine report, 24h objection forwarding and GUI opt-out change are all required.
Merely retaining objection without GUI status change fails 222.105(B).
72h is vaccine clock, not objection-forwarding clock; objector still reported.

items.rule: USP <800> §5.2 storage: antineoplastic requiring manipulation segregated negative pressure exterior ventilation and ≥12 ACPH; refrigerated antineoplastics need separate dedicated refrigerator.
items.topic: USP <800>: hazardous antineoplastic drug storage and environmental controls

option_verdicts.basis: Antineoplastic requiring compounding manipulation has negative-pressure separated storage with required ventilation.
USP does not universally demand separate rooms for every sterile and nonsterile HD.
Antineoplastic HD cold storage uses dedicated refrigerator in externally vented negative-pressure room with ≥12 ACPH.
Airflow/negative pressure cannot be routinely switched off when room unoccupied.

Provider treatment disclosure generally needs neither authorization nor minimum-necessary test.
